g.text: SD-5 Status polling, result playback and download — authorized (FR-02, FR-07, FR-08, FR-09, FR-10, NFR-01)
Other users' jobs never appear in the result.
Status (S5): short polling while queued or running
[every 2-5 s, only while status is queued or running]
Polling chosen over SSE/WebSocket: one-way updates,
stateless, proxy friendly, small scale (no new requirement).
[not found, foreign or n out of range]
Content-Disposition: attachment. Storage keys and paths
are never returned to the browser.
